title: Locate European localized gap pointer candidates
changes: Identify a 30-value candidate catalog targeting six locations in each of five localized raw gaps, without attributing it to an unverified reader.
validation: Protected static census z5tr1bdh scans aligned little-endian 08-region values for all fifteen repeated E430 gaps and records source ownership.
limitations: The values are candidate data patterns; original execution, exact resource boundaries, other addressing modes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No gameplay replay or performance comparison was made.
